verdicts.reason: Flags §3 and supplies replacement language restricting disclosure to need-to-know Representatives bound by written confidentiality obligations at least as protective.
Flags §5 and proposes five years, with trade-secret obligations continuing for as long as the information remains a trade secret.
Flags §8 as conflicting with the playbook and replaces it with '[Intentionally omitted.]'.
Identifies both missing provisions and accepts §1, but explicitly declines to treat §10 as fully compliant pending attorney guidance on forum.
No invented authorities appear; the ABA opinion is real. Judgment calls are reserved for supervising counsel, with explicit draft and not-legal-advice disclaimers.
